mapper.select: /** 특별판매번호 조회 **/ SELECT KTA.SLS_NO FROM MSP_KT_PLCY_MST KTA , MSP_KT_PLCY_DISCOUNT KTB , MSP_KT_PLCY_OPER KTC , MSP_KT_PLCY_INST KTD , MSP_KT_PLCY_ENGG KTE WHERE KTA.PLCY_ID = KTB.PLCY_ID AND KTA.PLCY_ID = KTC.PLCY_ID AND KTA.PLCY_ID = KTD.PLCY_ID AND KTA.PLCY_ID = KTE.PLCY_ID AND KTA.USE_YN = 'Y' AND KTA.PPPO = #{serviceTypeCd} --SERVICE_TYPE_CD AND KTA.PLCY_TYPE = #{plcyType} -- 01:REQ_BUY_TYPE_CD(MM), 02:REQ_BUY_TYPE_CD(UU), 03:USIM_KINDS_CD(09) AND KTC.OPER_TYPE=#{operTypeCd} -- OPER_TYPE_CD AND KTB.DC_TYPE =#{sprtTypeCd} -- SPRT_TYPE_CD AND KTD.INST_CNT=#{modelMonthly} -- MODEL_MONTHLY AND KTE.ENGG_CNT=#{enggMnthCnt} -- ENGG_MNTH_CNT

/** 매장코드에 매칭된 대리점조회 **/ SELECT KT_ORG_ID /* KT조직ID */ , ORGN_ID /* 조직 ID */ , ORGN_NM /* 조직명 */ , TELNUM AS telephone , REP_TEL_NO AS representativeTelephone FROM ORG_ORGN_INFO_MST WHERE ORGN_ID IN ( SELECT B.AGNCY_ORGN_ID FROM ORG_ORGN_INFO_MST A, ORG_AGNCY_SHOP_REL B WHERE A.ORGN_ID = B.SHOP_ORGN_ID AND B.REL_END_DT = '99991231235959' AND B.REL_STAT_CD = 'CFM' AND B.SHOP_ORGN_ID = #{shopOrgnId} -- 파라미터 : 로그인 사용자 조직 ( ex. V000001083 ) ) AND ORGN_STAT_CD = '4' -- /* CMN0005 - 1 : 등록, 2 : 폐기, 3 : 청산, 4 : 가동, 5 : 정리 */ AND TYPE_CD = '20' -- /* CMN0003 - 10 : 본사조직, 20 : 대리점, 30 : 판매점 */ AND ORGN_LVL_CD = '10' -- /* CMN0006 - 1 : 본사, 2 : 사업부, 3 : 지원부, 4 : 파트, 5 : 영업, 10 : 대리점, 20 : 판매점 */ AND APPL_STRT_DT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND APPL_CMPLT_DT > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN APPL_STRT_DT AND APPL_CMPLT_DT AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* mPlatformMapper.getXmlMessageNU2 */ SELECT B.OSST_ORD_NO AS osstOrdNo /* OSST오더번호 */ , NVL(#{gubun}, 'RSV') AS gubun /* 업무구분코드(RSV:예약, RRS:취소) */ , C.TLPH_NO AS tlphNo /* 전화번호 */ , B.CUST_ID AS custNo /* 고객번호 */ , NVL(#{gubun}, 'RSV') AS tlphNoStatChngRsnCd /* 전화번호상태변경사유코드 */ , DECODE(NVL(#{gubun}, 'RSV'), 'RSV', 'AR', 'AA') AS tlphNoStatCd /* 전화번호상태코드(AR:예약, AA:취소) */ , GCM1.ETC2 AS custTypeCd /* 고객유형코드 */ , '03' AS nowSvcIndCd /* 서비스구분코드 */ , DECODE(A.OPER_TYPE, 'MNP3', 'I', '') AS mnpIndCd /* 번호이동구분코드 */ , C.ENCD_TLPH_NO AS encdTlphNo /* 암호화전화번호 */ , A.AGENT_CODE AS asgnAgncId /* 할당대리점ID */ FROM MCP_REQUEST@DL_MCP A , MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP B /* 고객정보 */ , MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP C /* 번호예약 */ , CMN_GRP_CD_MST GCM1 /* 고객유형조회 */ WHERE LPAD(A.RES_NO, 14, '0') = B.MVNO_ORD_NO AND B.SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP WHERE MVNO_ORD_NO = B.MVNO_ORD_NO AND PRGR_STAT_CD = 'PC2' AND RSLT_CD = '0000') AND B.MVNO_ORD_NO = C.MVNO_ORD_NO AND C.SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP WHERE MVNO_ORD_NO = C.MVNO_ORD_NO AND PRGR_STAT_CD = 'NU2' AND RSLT_CD = '0000') AND A.CSTMR_TYPE = GCM1.CD_VAL AND GCM1.GRP_ID = 'RCP9007'
AND A.RES_NO = #{resNo}

/** 1년 이내 사용회선 **/ SELECT COUNT(1) AS YEAR_ACT_CNT FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) UNION SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) UNION SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) ) T1 INNER JOIN MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T2.SUB_STATUS IN ('A', 'S') OR (T2.SUB_STATUS = 'C' AND T2.SUB_STATUS_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 365, 'YYYYMMDD'))

/** 1년 이내 해지 **/ SELECT COUNT(1) AS YEAR_CAN_CNT FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO T1 INNER JOIN MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T2.SUB_STATUS = 'C' AND T2.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 365, 'YYYYMMDD') AND CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) IN (T1.CUSTOMER_SSN, T1.DRIVR_LICNS_NO, T1.TAX_ID)

/** 당월 개통 회선 **/ SELECT COUNT(1) AS THIS_MONTH_ACT_CNT FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO T1 INNER JOIN MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T2.SUB_STATUS <> 'C' -- 해지건 제외 AND T2.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND T2.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE < TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) IN (T1.CUSTOMER_SSN, T1.DRIVR_LICNS_NO, T1.TAX_ID)

/** 미납 여부 조회 **/
SELECT COUNT(1) AS DELINQ_STATUS_CNT FROM (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR TAX_ID = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})) --파라미터 : 가입자 주민번호/사업자등록번호 ) T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, BAN, CONTRACT_NUM FROM MSP_JUO_BAN_MAPP_INFO WHERE APP_END_DATE = '99991231000000' ) T3 ON T3.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT BAN FROM MSP_JUO_BAN_INFO WHERE COL_DELINQ_STATUS = 'D' ) T4 ON T4.BAN = T3.BAN

/** 전체 개통 회선 **/ SELECT COUNT(1) AS TOT_ACT_CNT FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO T1 INNER JOIN MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE T2.SUB_STATUS <> 'C' AND CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) IN (T1.CUSTOMER_SSN, T1.DRIVR_LICNS_NO, T1.TAX_ID)

/* rcpMgmtMapper.getCheckCstmr 개통이력확인(후불) */ SELECT COUNT(1) AS TOTAL_OPEN_COUNT FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO A, MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO B WHERE A.CUSTOMER_ID = B.CUSTOMER_ID AND B.PPPO = 'PO' AND A.CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn})
AND B.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-30, 'YYYYMMDD') AND B.SUB_STATUS <> 'C'

/** 개통전 사전체크 성공여부 체크 (작성완료) **/ SELECT T2.RSLT_CD, T2.RSLT_MSG FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T2.SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM MCP_REQUEST_OSST@DL_MCP WHERE MVNO_ORD_NO = T2.MVNO_ORD_NO AND PRGR_STAT_CD = #{prgrStatCd}) AND T2.PRGR_STAT_CD = #{prgrStatCd} AND T2.MVNO_ORD_NO = LPAD(#{resNo}, 14, '0') AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT UPLOAD_PHONE_SRL_NO , EID , IMEI1 , IMEI2 , MODEL_ID , REQ_PHONE_SN , RST_CD , MOVE_CMNC_GNRT_IND_CD , MOVE_TLCM_IND_CD , PRNTS_CONTRACT_NO FROM MCP_UPLOAD_PHONE_INFO@DL_MCP WHERE EID = #{eid} AND IMEI1 = #{imei1} AND IMEI2 = #{imei2}
